scope.note: Federal individual income tax return for tax year 2025. Wages from Forms W-2 and W-2c, Box 1, and the basic standard deduction only. No person aged 65 or over or blind, no dependents, no other income, no itemized deductions, no credits.

authority.citation: 26 U.S.C. 63(c)(7), as amended by Public Law 119-21, section 70102
authority.what_it_establishes: Section 70102(b) of Public Law 119-21 prints two of the amounts, $23,625 and $15,750, and section 70102(c) applies them to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024. It does not print the amount for a joint return. Rev. Proc. 2025-32 prints all four.

public-law-119-21.title: Public Law 119-21, An Act to provide for reconciliation pursuant to title II of H. Con. Res. 14 (July 4, 2025), 139 Stat. 72
public-law-119-21.quote: The amendments made by this section shall apply to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024.

irs-rev-proc-2024-40.title: Rev. Proc. 2024-40 (inflation-adjusted items for taxable years beginning in 2025)
irs-rev-proc-2024-40.quote: This revenue procedure sets forth inflation-adjusted items for 2025 for various Code provisions as in effect on October 22, 2024.

irs-rev-proc-2025-32.title: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (modifies Rev. Proc. 2024-40 for 2025; inflation-adjusted items for 2026)
irs-rev-proc-2025-32.quote: Accordingly, section 2.15(1) of Rev. Proc. 2024-40 is removed.

versions.dates: From the date Rev. Proc. 2024-40 says its figures are as of (PDF page 4) to the day before Public Law 119-21 was enacted.
From the enactment of Public Law 119-21 on July 4, 2025. Its section 70102(c) applies the amounts to the whole of tax year 2025.

enacted_by.states: Prints $23,625 (PDF page 88) and $15,750 (PDF page 89), for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2024. It does not print $31,500.
